claims.family: for each of the five predictions G: H0(G) is the SIMPLE fine-grid hybrid null that the calibration actually simulates: the true cross section equals G on the fine 5D grid (fine-ratio null truth: the J integrals exactly G's) with MnvTune v1's shape and G's finite-MC fine-cell fluctuations below it; for MnvTune (the analysis MC, rho = 1) this is H0 exactly. Test domains: the 109 supported J cells; GiBUU the 72 of them with p_parallel < 6 GeV/c (pz index <= 1). Two tests each (total, shape-only): 10 tests
claims.rejection: H0(G) is rejected at familywise 0.05 only by s5p_inference.holm_determined on the CLAIM p-values: the largest p over the process-shift variants (bias-aligned upper-bound D, c in 0, 1/2, 1) AND the sub-fine-residual variants F +- 2 delta_M1 (kappa = 2; delta_M1 = the fine-minus-merged-x2 asimov difference; justification: the W-norm step between resolutions shrinks by 0.45-0.76 per halving, so the residual below the fine grid is ~1-3 times the last step; kappa = 2 is its central value). Every rejection is also flagged 'robust to the sub-fine residual' or not at kappa = 3 (report only, frozen now). A step rejects only when the 95% Clopper-Pearson interval of k/B lies entirely below its Holm threshold; an interval containing it stops with 'undetermined'
claims.non_rejection: reported with the power of the same test at the null it belongs to: at the MnvTune null P1r-P3r a = 1 (200 each), at the GENIE CV null P1r-P3r a = 1 (200 each, as amendment 8 M4 froze); at 0.05 and at the Holm first-step level 0.005 under the claim rule (all variants, M1 included) with the determinacy rule; both nulls run to at least B = 1200 before they may stop (so the 0.005 level is attainable: a k = 0 decision needs B >= 737). A non-rejection of GENIE MEC, NuWro or GiBUU carries NO power statement (their non-centralities differ strongly from GENIE CV's); low power is a limitation, never agreement

calibration.process: s5p_nullexp.py at the null truth (fine-ratio null; MnvTune: rho = 1): per experiment fresh Poisson pseudo-data from MC half B and background source C, refinement refit, R (5 iterations) on MC half A; nuisance draws on the pseudo-data source: one PPFX flux universe (of 100); EVERY interaction-model band at one of its universes (34 bands), coherently for the background source and the signal response with fine-cell truth preservation; the four weight-only detector bands (dump; MinosEfficiency's 18 reco-failing NaN rows set to 1 and counted, non-finite values refused where used); downstream: lateral z_b Delta_b (Delta from the ten real-data endpoint unfolds, runs/s3/latunf), normalization 1.4% z, the data's rounding noise (20 real-data jitters), the prediction's finite-MC residual (drawn per experiment, keyed by seed)
calibration.sequential_rule: batches of 200 seeds in fixed order per null, at most 1999; before each batch s5p_seqstop.py evaluates both claim p-values on the finished products (partials excluded) and stops the null when s5p_inference.sequential_decision stops both (99.5% Clopper-Pearson look interval: no decision threshold straddled, T7 precision at the point estimate, or an upper end below every threshold); a meter cap refusal writes a 'budget' final status, the last line a 'batches exhausted' one; the p-value stays valid at the B reached (the determinacy rule decides claims). A stop is TERMINAL (the controller exits 3 at once when a final status exists). The MnvTune and GENIE CV nulls may not stop by the rule before B = 1200. A meter cap refusal is retried once after every production job of every lane has left the scheduler (all reservations closed at measured cost), then recorded as a terminal 'budget' stop; a budget stop at B = 0 leaves the null 'not calibrated' (it stays in the Holm family with p = 1)
calibration.seeds: calibration 1200000 + 20000 i (i = 0 MnvTune, 1 GENIE CV, 2 GENIE MEC, 3 NuWro, 4 GiBUU); power MnvTune null 1451000/1461000/1471000 (a = 1), GENIE CV null 1481000/1491000/1501000; the generator refuses overlapping ranges
calibration.metric: W = V + diag Var(mu_G); V = the standardized Ledoit-Wolf covariance (s5p_joint build-v) of the 200-experiment all-band design pilot s3v (MnvTune null, GEANT detector bands from the bank, MinosEfficiency absent; seeds 965000-965199); V sets power only; its sha256 is recorded here at the freeze; checks on V at the freeze: exactly 200 products (965000-965199), none partial, 34 model and 3 GEANT draws each; shrinkage, median relative SD, lateral symmetry; W positive definite with its condition number, on the full and the GiBUU domain; V's sha256 and the design's recorded in V's metadata
calibration.process_shift: D16-<null>.npz (state/s5p/stage3/f4/, digests in the design), mode bias_aligned_upper, variants c in (0, 1/2, 1)
calibration.m1_shift: state/s5p/stage3/m1/fine-minus-mid-<g>.npz (digests in the design), kappa 2 (claim), kappa_robust 3 (report); MnvTune: none
